item.title: Blues honour Arthur Labinjo-Hughes at Annual Memorial Matchday
item.description: Last month, Birmingham City hosted their annual Arthur’s Memorial Matchday during their home fixture against Stoke City, held in honour of the late Arthur Labinjo-Hughes.
